description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mindless Automaton with haste, that enters the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing both +1/+1 counters from it.
Mindless Automaton dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Mindless Automaton ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
